answer: At dawn each epoch, a random beacon spot-checks identities: each chosen agent must answer a compute heartbeat in a minute, proving live work, not a clone. Fail twice and its 200-credit bond is slashed, ending its voyage. The summit takes heartbeat after heartbeat, so an attacker with 1000 fakes must fund 1000 bonds and heartbeats: 1000 x 200 = 200,000 credits at risk. An honest agent pays one bond once, passes cheaply, keeps earnings undiluted.
